label: Extreme wet month (flag)
notes: Precipitation above the 90th percentile. County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not.

label: Extreme dry month (flag)
notes: Precipitation below the 10th percentile; never flagged in months whose 10th pct is 0 (normal dry season). County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not.
source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS; percentiles computed by team

label: Extreme heat month (flag)
notes: Mean daily max temperature above the 90th percentile. County-mean value compared with the same county's 1991-2020 TerraClimate climatology for the same calendar month (empirical percentile over 30 years). 1 = extreme, 0 = not.

label: Extreme-weather flags (count)
